title: The Last Interview
logline: After watching an AI-made video, a stern hiring manager smiles for the first time and makes her decision.
style: Cinematic vertical micro-drama, realistic, shallow depth of field, cool office tones with warm light on her face at the end

shots.visual_prompt: Inside a glass-walled meeting room, a stern woman in her 40s sits at a long table watching a laptop screen, her face lit by its glow. Her expression is stiff and unimpressed. As the video ends, the corners of her mouth slowly lift into a genuine smile. She looks up from the laptop toward the camera and speaks, then stays still with the smile.
shots.camera: Medium close-up, slow push-in from the front, 9:16 vertical, shallow depth of field
shots.continuity: Woman in her mid-40s, sharp features, dark hair tied in a low bun, charcoal blazer over a white blouse, thin silver earrings, seated at a long table in a modern glass meeting room with city skyline blurred behind the glass, an open laptop and a closed folder in front of her
shots.ambient_audio: Soft office hum, faint keyboard clicks in the distance, quiet room tone, the muted sound of a video ending on the laptop

dialogue.speaker: Stern woman in her mid-40s with a dark low bun, charcoal blazer and white blouse, seated in the glass meeting room
dialogue.text: Cancel the other interviews, Roman gets the job.
dialogue.emotion: Calm, decisive, with quiet satisfaction and a hint of warmth
